flags.issue: UNDECIDABLE: The framework computes a Plagiarism Risk Score using a deterministic cosine similarity threshold (> 0.8) on AI-generated CodeBERT embeddings, and a Bias Propagation Index checking against a dictionary of terms (described as BERT semantic similarity but implemented in the code snippet as exact string matching). It is unclear if applying deterministic thresholds/dictionary checks to AI model embeddings and outputs counts as a deterministic, non-AI rules-based check.
